name: Heba Al Nabulsi
title: Social media strategist and communication consultant
bio_short: Social media strategist and communication consultant. Director of Solution Consultants at Emplifi, a global social media management platform. Founder of #LetsTalkSocialWithHebz. Graduate of the American University of Sharjah. Based in Dubai.
bio: Heba is a social media strategist and communication consultant with more than a decade of experience in integrated communications. She is a Director of Solution Consultants at Emplifi, a global social media management and customer experience platform, where she advises clients across the Middle East, Africa, Turkey and South Asia on social media measurement, market intelligence and digital communications strategy. She is the founder of the #LetsTalkSocialWithHebz community and a regular contributor to industry commentary on social media trends, including analysis of brand engagement during Ramadan for regional and international media.  Her approach combines strategic thinking with practical execution, helping organisations develop digital communication strategies that deliver measurable results. She holds a Bachelor's degree from the American University of Sharjah.  At ISOC, Heba delivers social media, digital communications and corporate communications programmes. Her role at a global social media technology company gives her direct access to platform data and analytics that informs her training with current, evidence-based insights. Her bilingual capability in English and Arabic makes her well suited to training programmes in the Gulf region where organisations must manage social media presences in both languages and navigate the specific dynamics of the Middle East digital landscape. Heba is based in Dubai.
